items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: The old band director we had, he was very particular about his music.

ctx.x: Into the Navy? No. World War II.

World War II, I was seventeen years old, and I was playing in Mottville, Louisiana, and there was a Navy bandmaster going around recruiting musicians to play in the Navy band to be stationed here in New Orleans. And I said, now I'm seventeen years old and I didn't have to register for the service, because you had to register at eighteen, I was only seventeen. I said, now if I wait another year, they might put me in the Army. So I got a chance to play with the Navy band, and I have to fight. So I volunteered. But…
Who was the band director? Edwards.
